name: Just A Good Suit of Armor

system.description:
Cunei Myrgha Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Rare, Earth. 1 item slot. Attunement.

Prerequisites: Proficiency[3], Heavy Armor Proficiency

An artfully crafted, but simple, set of iron armor. Anyone would be proud to wear it, and shocked at how comfortable it is.

Artisanal Armor (Passive): This Armor is a Professional Iron Set, but provides +10PD, instead of +9PD.

Rulebook p.46.
